# BILL-001 for 50.00 CAD, posted and unpaid. On the day its page says it was
# paid, the bank holds a customer's deposit of 50.00 carrying the bill's payment
# memo: money coming in, where a bill's payment is money going out. Load after
# `payment_roundtrip_accounts.txt`.
vendor "V001"
	name: "Supplier"
	currency: CAD

bill "BILL-001"
	vendor_id: "V001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "Supplies"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: 1
		price: 50
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-01
		due: 2026-01-31
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable"
		memo: "Bill BILL-001"
		accumulate: true

2026-01-15 * "Customer deposit"
	Assets:Bank 50.00 CAD
		memo: "Payment BILL-001"
	Income:Sales -50.00 CAD
